findings.summary: Self-review dropped a 2-second wall-clock assertion from the threaded page-load test: the 5-second client timeout already proves no stall (the single-threaded control never answers), and a tight timing bound would flake on a loaded CI host.

Onboarding round 4 (51f5033b) made the intake suite threaded before activation, so it was removed from the guard's known-holdouts list; only test_my_data_browser.py (onboarding claim) and the opt-in Workshop proof remain.

The package's own completion check required the red dark-theme baseline to pass. Root cause: DarkThemeStaysLightInABrowserTests hard-coded the shell's navy body ink rgb(6, 26, 58), but the Sage Mist public resume's light ink is green rgb(40, 79, 59), so /petec/resume failed on main too. Commit 085f5fca keeps the 'dark inputs change nothing versus a no-dark control' comparison and replaces the pinned colour with a relative-luminance < 0.2 check (navy 0.011, green 0.064, near-white >= 0.8). Test-only, same claimed file, no colour rule.
